conventions.denominators: D_i = (q+V_i)^2 - m_i^2 - mu2  (m_i^2 written m_i below)
conventions.rank: weighted degree of N(q,mu2): q counts 1, mu2 counts 2; r = n+2
conventions.qbar: qbar = q + V_{i1} with i1 the first (lowest) index of the cut
conventions.qe_i: qbar . e_i with Ninja's cut bases (basis.cc): e1,e2 null in the plane of the cut momenta (bubble: e2 = reference vector), e3,e4 null transverse, e3.e4 = -e1.e2 = mp34
conventions.residue_degree: R_k = r - n + k = k + 2 for r = n+2 (weighted)
conventions.integral_normalisation: OneLOop/Ninja: d^dq/(i pi^(d/2) r_Gamma) mu^(2eps); rational terms are normalisation independent
conventions.masters: B_{1^a}(s,m1,m2): coefficient of p^mu1..p^mua in int q^mu1..q^mua/((q^2-m1)((q+p)^2-m2)), p = V_{i2}-V_{i1}, OneLOop convention (oneloopmaster two_point.rs b1,b11,b111,b1111)

pentagon.note: unchanged for every rank; not needed with the mu-expansion

tadpole.note: slot 9 (qe1 qe2) unused as in Ninja; all 20 new terms spurious (odd in qbar)

residues.hexagon_and_higher: none (5 denominators fix q and mu2)
residues.zero_point: c_empty * prod_all D_i: needed at r = n+2 for every n (constant if all tadpoles share one basis {e1..e4}, as Ninja's tadpole_basis does; degree <= 1 for n = 1 or for independent tadpole bases). Vanishes on every cut, integrates to 0 (scaleless); matters only for global N=N tests.

triangle_T3.levels: level i = t^(R-i), mu2^j for j <= i/2 (ascending j)

bubble_T2.levels: level i = t^(R-i), x^a mu2^j with a+2j <= i, ordered by a then j

box.c0: average of N/prod(D) on the two 4-dim solutions l+-, mu2 = 0
box.mu_expansion: q = (q0 - V0) + t*v, mu2 = t^2 v^2 + mu0 with q0 = (l+ + l-)/2 (qbar coords), v = Vort, mu0 = q0^2 - m_{i1}  (EXACT d-dim cut; Ninja's rank<=n+1 convention mu2 = t^2 v^2 is wrong at the 3rd term)
box.terms: n0,n1,n2 = coefficients of t^r, t^(r-1), t^(r-2)
box.division: for each uncut l: d0 = 2 v.kk, d1 = 2 q0.kk + f_l (kk = V_l - V0, f_l = kk^2 + m_i1 - m_l); n0/=d0; n1=(n1-d1*n0)/d0; n2=(n2-d1*n1)/d0
box.c2,c3 (tests only): one finite-mu2 sample s: P(s)=avg, Q(s)=diff/(2 x v2) minus pentagons; c2 = (P - c0 - c4 s^2 - c6 s^3)/s, c3 = (Q - c1 - c5 s^2)/s
box.no_mu_expansion: even part c0+c2 s+c4 s^2+c6 s^3 needs 4 mu2 samples (e.g. 0,s,-s,2s), odd part 3

triangle.expansions: A: q = amu + t e3 + (param+mu2)/t * e4/(2 mp34);  B: e3 <-> e4;  mindeg 5 both
triangle.c0,c7,c14: (Q_A[t^0 mu2^j] + Q_B[t^0 mu2^j])/2, j = 0,1,2 (box terms cancel in the average)

bubble.expansions: A: q = e1eff + x e2eff + t e3 + (p0+p1 x+p2 x^2+mu2)/t * e4/(2 mp34), mindeg 4; B: e3 <-> e4, mindeg 3 (only if tadpoles of its lines are needed or tests)
bubble.qe2^a qe4^b mu2^j: Q_A[t^b x^a mu2^j] / (mp12^a mp34^b)  (b >= 0; b = 0 gives the 9 orientation-free coefficients incl. all non-spurious ones)
bubble.subtractions: parent triangles (tri_to_bub), applied to Q_A (all slots) and Q_B (t >= 1)

tadpole.expansions: A: q = -V0 + t e1 + (m^2+mu2)/t * e2/(2 mp12);  B: q = -V0 + t e3 + (m^2+mu2)/t * e4/(2 mp34);  mindeg 3 both
tadpole.subtractions: parent bubbles (bub_to_tad) and triangles (tri_to_tad), t^0 and t^0 mu2 slots

subtractions.description:
Part (c): symbolic derivation of Ninja's coefficient-level subtraction terms
(the analogue of the FORM output in coefficient_level_subs.cc) for rank r = n+2.

A higher-point residue monomial M = mu2^j * prod_i L_i, written on the lower cut's
Laurent parametrisation (L_i = alpha_i t + beta_i + gamma_i / t), divided by the
uncut denominators D_l = d0 t + d1 + d2/t, has a large-t expansion whose
polynomial part P[M / prod D] is what must be subtracted from the lower cut's
Laurent coefficients.  With z = 1/t:
     M / prod_{l=1..m} D_l = mu2^j z^(m-a) * prod_i(alpha_i + beta_i z + gamma_i z^2)
                                           / prod_l(d0_l + d1_l z + d2_l z^2),
so the coefficient of t^b (b >= 0) is mu2^j [z^(a-m-b)] of the Taylor series.

Three kinds (as in Ninja):
  tri->bub : triangle monomial on the bubble parametrisation
             qbar = eb1 + x eb2 + t eb3 + X/t eb4,  X = P0 + P1 x + P2 x^2 + mu2,
             L_u = t U3 + (U1 + x U2) + X U4/t   with Ui = eb_i.u, u in {et3, et4},
             D   = 2 q.k + f  = t 2K3 + (2K1 + 2 x K2 + f) + X 2K4 / t,  Ki = eb_i.k
  tri->tad : triangle monomial on the tadpole parametrisation qbar = t e3 + (P+mu2)/t e4,
             L_u = t U3 + (P+mu2) U4/t,  U3 = e3.u, U4 = e4.u,
             D_i = t 2A_i + f_i + (P+mu2) 2B_i/t,  A_i = e3.k_i, B_i = e4.k_i  (i = 0,1)
  bub->tad : bubble monomial qb2^a qb3^b qb4^c mu2^j on the tadpole parametrisation,
             qb2 = t S2 + W + (P+mu2) T2/t,  qb3 = t S3 + (P+mu2) T3/t,  qb4 = t S4 + (P+mu2) T4/t
             (S_i = e3.eb_i, T_i = e4.eb_i, W = eb2.kbol),  D = t 2A + f + (P+mu2) 2B/t.

Outputs: formulas.json section "subtractions" (sympy-printable strings) for every
NEW rank n+2 monomial and every Laurent slot it feeds, plus a numerical
validation of the same engine against original Ninja's FORM-generated x1cuts
routines (old monomials, rank n+1 layouts) through ninja_harness/harness.
subtractions.reuse: the complete contributions of all rank<=n+1 monomials are exactly original Ninja's x1cuts::correctbubcoeffs / correcttadcoeffs / correcttadcoeffsfull (verified to 1e-15 against libninja); at r=n+2 they are reused unchanged, re-indexed by slot label [t,x,mu2] into the rank n+2 layouts. The terms below are ADDED for the new monomials.

symbols.tri_to_bub: U_i = eb_i.u (u = et3 or et4 as stated), K_i = eb_i.k (eb1 = e1effl, eb2 = e2eff, eb3 = growing e3, eb4 = e4eff), f, P0..P2 = Ninja bubble params
symbols.tri_to_tad: U3 = e.u, U4 = e4eff.u (e = growing tadpole vector), A_i = e.k_i, B_i = e4eff.k_i, f0, f1, P = m^2
symbols.bub_to_tad: S_i = e.eb_i, T_i = e4eff.eb_i, W = eb2.kbol (kbol = V0_bubble - V0_tadpole), A = e.k, B = e4eff.k, f, P = m^2

rational_terms_general.general: I_n[mu^(2a) f] = (-eps)(1-eps)...(a-1-eps) I_n^(d+2a)[f] = -(a-1)! x Res_eps I_n^(d+2a)[f]

tensor_masters.I2[(qbar.e2)^a]: (p.e2)^a B_{1^a}, a = 0..4 (e2 null kills all g^{mu nu} terms)
